clue.text: Game change coming around at one

indicators.note: the coins come around the other pieces, enclosing them

parts.note: small change is loose coins, pence
taken as written
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone notes how a game shifts as one o'clock approaches.
explanation.walkthrough: 'change' looks like part of the definition of a game, but it is coins; 'coming around' wraps them about AT and I.
explanation.definitionFit: Patience is the solitaire card game played by one person.

clue.text: Overlook success getting close

parts.note: a pass in an exam is a success
by means near or close

explanation.surface: Someone ignores a near triumph.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass by something is to disregard or overlook it.

clue.text: 25's items beginning to tempt French painter

indicators.note: the opening letter of the word that follows

parts.note: Henri Rousseau was a French painter

explanation.surface: A bride's belongings are just starting to lure a French artist.
explanation.walkthrough: 25 is BRIDE, so the definition is a bride's collection of clothes and linen.
explanation.definitionFit: A trousseau is the clothes and linen a woman collects for her marriage.

clue.text: Planet's core, hot to the very bottom

indicators.note: the letter for hot goes down to the end, the bottom of a down entry

parts.note: the heart is the core
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: A planet's core is hot right down to its depths.
explanation.walkthrough: H moves from the front of HEART to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Earth is our planet, the third from the Sun.

clue.text: Endless stuff around cavity showing disease

indicators.note: the trimmed stuffing goes round the cavity
without an end, losing its last letter

parts.note: to cram is to stuff
a hole is a cavity

explanation.surface: Constant stuffing around a tooth cavity reveals an illness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endless' drops the last letter of the word for stuff, and 'around' puts the remainder about the cavity.
explanation.definitionFit: Cholera is an infectious bacterial disease of the gut.

clue.text: A short over

parts.note: short-tempered, as in cross

explanation.surface: A terse fragment that could be a cricket scorer's note.
explanation.definitionFit: Over and across are synonyms for going to the far side, as over or across the road.

clue.text: Happy to keep at home — on this one's abroad?

indicators.note: the happy word keeps the other inside

parts.note: content means happy
in means at home

explanation.surface: A contented homebody wonders whether to go abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to keep' puts the home word inside the happy one. To the British, 'on the Continent' means abroad in mainland Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Britons call mainland Europe the Continent, so to be on it is to be abroad.

clue.text: Japanese city huge — there's another name for it

parts.note: OS stands for outsize, huge
aka, also known as, introduces another name

explanation.surface: A big Japanese city goes by an alias.
explanation.definitionFit: Osaka is a major port city in Japan.

clue.text: Sulphur given to fast bowler, one requiring a supply of oxygen?

definitions.text: one requiring a supply of oxygen

parts.note: S is the chemical symbol for sulphur
in cricket a paceman is a fast bowler

explanation.surface: A fast bowler is handed sulphur and needs an oxygen tank.
explanation.definitionFit: An astronaut in space depends on a supplied oxygen source to breathe.

clue.text: Contrary Othello put on performance in sales area

indicators.note: placed after, so the turned piece follows the other

parts.note: a show is a performance

indicators.note: contrary means turned the opposite way, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: Othello is Shakespeare's Moor of Venice

explanation.surface: An awkward Othello performs in a shop's display area.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contrary' turns MOOR into ROOM, which is put on SHOW.
explanation.definitionFit: A showroom is a room where goods such as cars are displayed for sale.

clue.text: Capital city, a rank sort of Anatolian capital

indicators.note: a sort of rank means its letters arranged in another order

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the capital letter of a word is its first

explanation.surface: A traveller describes a rather foul Anatolian capital city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort of' rearranges A RANK into ANKAR; 'capital' gives the A of Anatolian.
explanation.definitionFit: Ankara is the capital of Turkey, in Anatolia.

clue.text: More than a trace of quartz in copper metal

indicators.note: a run of letters picked out of the words that follow

explanation.surface: Quartz in a copper ore contains a little more than trace minerals.
explanation.definitionFit: Zinc is a bluish-white metallic element.

clue.text: Talk about nonsense artist!

indicators.note: said out loud, so the word for nonsense is pronounced

parts.note: bosh is nonsense

explanation.surface: An exasperated cry at an artist who talks rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Hieronymus Bosch was the Dutch painter of fantastical scenes.

clue.text: Murder inmate and lie in pieces

indicators.note: broken into bits, so the letters are reassembled

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A violent instruction to kill a prisoner and leave him dismembered.
explanation.definitionFit: To eliminate someone is a euphemism for killing them.

clue.text: Raise first of boys out in the country

indicators.note: out signals the letters are put out of order

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the opening letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Someone urges bringing up the eldest son abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first of' gives B; 'out' rearranges RAISE plus B.
explanation.definitionFit: Serbia is a Balkan country.

clue.text: Serious lot of money on sport

parts.note: bad means serious, as a bad accident
a mint is a lot of money

explanation.surface: Heavy betting on a sporting event.
explanation.definitionFit: Badminton is a racket sport played with a shuttlecock.

clue.text: Different plugging tea in place of buns

indicators.note: the first piece is plugged into the second, filling its middle

parts.note: cha is informal British for tea
else means other or different

explanation.surface: A different brew takes the place of buns at teatime.
explanation.walkthrough: ELSE plugs CHA. Chelsea is a district of London, which gave its name to the Chelsea bun, a sticky currant bun.
explanation.definitionFit: The London district gives its name to the Chelsea bun, so it is the place of buns.

clue.text: Most sexy outfit in the rest of Spain, cut short

indicators.note: the outfit sits inside the shortened rest
trimmed of its last letter

parts.note: a siesta is the Spanish afternoon rest
a team is an outfit or group

explanation.surface: The sexiest clothes are on show at a curtailed Spanish nap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut short' makes SIEST; TEAM goes in.
explanation.definitionFit: Steamy means sexy or erotic, so steamiest is the most sexy.

clue.text: Sauce turned into lake, hospital admitted

indicators.note: the hospital letter is let in

parts.note: became means turned into

explanation.surface: Sauce was tipped into a lake and someone landed in hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: Béchamel is a white sauce made with milk and a roux.

clue.text: Fuss right behind old money for the country

indicators.note: the fuss and right come behind, after the old money

parts.note: the ecu was an old French coin and a European currency unit
ado is fuss

explanation.surface: A row breaks out over old currency in a nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Ecuador is a South American country.

clue.text: Syncopated piece with a scale

parts.note: a rag is a piece of ragtime, syncopated music

explanation.surface: A ragtime tune comes with a scale.
explanation.definitionFit: A raga is an Indian melodic mode or scale.

clue.text: Club Tropicana's fourth, say

indicators.note: fourth picks the letter in fourth place of the word before

parts.note: to utter is to say

explanation.surface: The title of a pop song, evoking a nightclub, and its fourth track.
explanation.walkthrough: Club Tropicana is a 1983 Wham! song; the fourth letter of Tropicana is P.
explanation.definitionFit: A putter is the golf club used on the green.

clue.text: Apply to see daubing of painter

indicators.note: daubing paint about messily, the letters are smeared into a new order

explanation.surface: An instruction to look at a painter's smears.
explanation.definitionFit: To pertain is to relate or apply to something.

clue.text: Ugly setter with good skin?

indicators.note: the good word forms a skin around the setter

parts.note: holy means good, virtuous
the setter refers to himself as me

explanation.surface: A setter boasts of a fine complexion despite plain looks.
explanation.walkthrough: In American usage homely means unattractive.
explanation.definitionFit: In American English homely means plain or unattractive.

clue.text: With vibrating sound, bell perhaps is an excellent thing

parts.note: a hum is a low vibrating sound
a dinger is something that dings, as a bell does

explanation.surface: A ringing bell that hums is praised as a marvel.
explanation.definitionFit: A humdinger is informal for a remarkable or outstanding example of something.

clue.text: Note that may be read either way

indicators.text: that may be read either way
indicators.note: the answer reads identically forwards and backwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A musical note that reads the same both ways.
explanation.definitionFit: A minim is a half note in music.

clue.text: I'm into books — vacant character is a simple type

indicators.note: the first-person phrase goes into the books

parts.note: B is book, so BB is books
taken as written without the apostrophe
the letter O is a character empty in its middle

explanation.surface: A self-styled reader concedes an empty-headed nature.
explanation.definitionFit: A bimbo is a derogatory term for an attractive but unintelligent person.

clue.text: British travel to see The Woman In White, perhaps?

parts.note: to ride is to travel

explanation.surface: A Briton goes to see a stage version of a Wilkie Collins novel.
explanation.walkthrough: The Woman in White is a Wilkie Collins novel; a bride is a woman dressed in white.
explanation.definitionFit: A bride traditionally wears white at her wedding.

clue.text: A few ticks, microscopic

definitions.meaning: a short time, a few ticks of the clock

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a sixty-second span of time and, said differently, tiny.

clue.text: Indonesian policy to infiltrate headquarters

indicators.note: the policy gets inside the headquarters

parts.note: a base is headquarters
a line is a policy, as in the party line

explanation.surface: An Indonesian spy has a plan to get into the command centre.
explanation.definitionFit: Balinese describes someone from Bali, an Indonesian island.

clue.text: Priest carrying in plate

indicators.note: the priest holds the other word inside

parts.note: a lama is a Buddhist priest in Tibet

explanation.surface: A priest brings in a plate.
explanation.definitionFit: A lamina is a thin plate or layer of material.

clue.text: Ascent possibly on line to become descent?

indicators.note: possibly signals a rearranged version of the word

parts.note: taken as written
RY is the abbreviation for railway, a rail line

explanation.surface: A riddle wonders how going up could turn into going down.
explanation.definitionFit: Ancestry is lineage, descent from one's forebears.
